text:
Maya Singh: Arbor Health asked for a perf POC to validate sustained 2.5k QPS for short patient-summary generation. They care most about p95 < 200ms and stability during 30s morning spikes. Need plan + pricing by tomorrow noon.

Ethan Cole: Quick clarifying Qs: is 2.5k QPS all short (~150 tokens) or mixed? Any embedding/rerank calls? Also which model family are they testing?

Maya Singh: Buyer says ~90% short (120-160 tokens), 10% medium (300 tokens), embeddings ~3%. Model family: open-30B variant.

Rachael Kim: Proposed test: 10m ramp to 2.5k, 25m steady, then two 30s spikes at +150% during steady state, capture p50/p95/p99, errors, and GPU metrics. Pin model version and disable background warmup for repeatability.

Ethan Cole: Load runner command (pseudo):
```
run-load --target https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate --rate 2500 --duration 00:35:00 \\n  --spikes "30s:+150%@10m,30s:+150%@20m" --body sample_prompts.json \\n  --hdr "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

SecOps Lead: Security note: if they require HSM BYOK we escalate to Private. For Dedicated we can do customer-managed keys without HSM and provide audit logs. Need buyer to confirm residency and SIEM integration.

Rachael Kim: Preliminary sizing: 2.5k * avg 150 tokens ~375k tokens/s. For 30B FP16 with KV cache expect ~3 A100-eq; with 4-bit quant maybe 2. Will run a sim tonight and post GPU-seconds.

perf-bot: schedule created: arbor-poc-4420003000 (runner perf-node-2).

Maya Singh: Pricing ask: procurement wants 1-month reserved and hosted on-demand estimates. Also include burst-credit pricing and overage rate.

Ethan Cole: I'll run the sim and post results by 9:30am PT tomorrow. Also drafting a one-page note: "Dedicated vs Hosted: impact on microburst tails".

Maya Singh: Thanks 44d. I'll book a 30m alignment with Arbor Health for tomorrow 8am PT and attach their questionnaire and prompts.

Rachael Kim: Ops runbook: reserve stage dedicated min=2 max=5, enable KV prefix cache, route medium requests to separate pool if we see OOMs. Set alert p95>300ms.

Maya Singh: Summary actions:
- Ethan: sim + GPU sizing
- Rachael: reserve pool + runbook
- SecOps: draft security answers (hosted/dedicated/private)
- Maya: sync with buyer and collate quote

Maya Singh: Any blockers?

Ethan Cole: None, starting the sim now.

perf-bot: run started arbor-poc-4420003000 (ETA ~25m).

Maya Singh: Great, will review results and draft quotes after sim.
